scope: forms, tethered pen, stamp, tray, cloth and contact traces
strengths: Clear check-in function and service-opening hierarchy
Readable framed door with angular inset panels and useful hardware
Restrained off-white, navy and orange colour blocking
Warm practical against cooler office and dark facility context
Sparse procedural signage with a coercive second meaning
Purposeful worker-prop cluster with negative space

defects.region: tan cloth below and left of paper tray
defects.observation: Reads as a thin flat sheet or envelope. Broad folds, folded thickness and soft textile edge response are absent at the fixed image scale; neutral material view confirms the read.
defects.requirement: readable fabric and object-specific prop geometry
defects.correction: Add visible folded thickness, a broad asymmetric crease or turned corner and a soft matte response without high-frequency weave.
defects.closure_evidence: Cloth is identifiable at the unchanged 1067 x 600 beauty frame scale.

defects.region: counter mat, stamp-pad housing and dark door reveal
defects.observation: Mat is a flat green-grey rectangle, pad housing is a group of clean sharp boxes, and dark reveal does not clearly demonstrate rubber. Rubber and molded plastic cannot be confidently distinguished from coated metal.
defects.requirement: distinct plastic and rubber material families
defects.correction: Give mat a soft or tapered visible edge and differentiated matte response; give selected plastic housing a molded lip or seam and restrained distinct response; make any seal evidence visible within the unchanged reveal.
defects.closure_evidence: Beauty and same-view neutral images clearly distinguish rubber, plastic and coated metal.

defects.region: lever/latch, kickplate, counter lip, tray edge and work mat
defects.observation: A few thin kickplate marks are visible, but most selected handling surfaces remain pristine. The sparse faint marks do not adequately demonstrate everyday use.
defects.requirement: localized plausible handling wear and active institutional use
defects.correction: Author a small set of visible causal traces at handle/latch, kick zone, counter lip and writing/sorting zone while retaining quiet broad surfaces.
defects.closure_evidence: Localized wear is visible and plausible in the unchanged beauty frames without a magnified crop or blanket grunge.

defects.region: junction and stepped conduit beside staff door
defects.observation: Utility route reads as a crisp stepped dark line with limited visible bend, termination or fastening specificity.
defects.correction: Clarify one fastening or termination and intentional conduit/trunking bend treatment without adding decorative service clutter.
defects.closure_evidence: Fixed beauty frames communicate manufactured utility construction; support remains a separate numerical check.

local_requirements.object_specific_geometry: PARTIAL; cloth, mat and plastic housing under-authored

evidence_limits: Pixels do not prove support contact, envelope preservation or numerical clearances.
Door foot and floor threshold are largely cropped.
Checker diagnostics cannot certify UV packing, texel density or geometry validity.
Glass reflections are not clear enough to count as unmistakable human fingerprints.
No previous review or builder history was used, so no regression comparison is claimed.
next_review: Repair all P1 findings, rerender the same three beauty views and obtain another independent local slice review before expansion.
